|lore=Ubrikkian sail barge. Custom built for Jabba with an armored hull and weaponry. Top speed of 100 kph. Used by the Hutt crimelord on his many trips to Mos Eisley.
|game_text=Deploys only on Tatooine. Once per turn, you may ▼ Passenger Deck, Jabba, or Pote aboard. May add 8 passengers. Your aliens deploy -1 aboard. Scum And Villainy may deploy here. Immune to attrition while Passenger Deck on table.

The 30 March announcement adds one driver to the surviving original wording. The full remaster retains the driver and eight passengers, drops the alien discount, names the deploy phase for the single aboard pull, and sets attrition immunity below 6 instead of depending on Passenger Deck.
